scripts.preview: astro build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

APP_SECRET.description: A random string of **32+ characters**. Enter it once at `/admin` to create the first admin. Do not delete it. Make one: `openssl rand -base64 32`

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Email addresses that may become admins, separated by commas, such as `you@example.com,colleague@example.com`.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: The Turnstile secret key. The form accepts no messages until this and the site key are both set.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: The Turnstile site key, a public value. It can stay empty at first; the form accepts no messages until it is set.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Slack gets only "1 new inquiry" and an admin link, never the form input.

DB.description: The D1 database for inquiries and admin accounts. `npm run deploy` creates the tables.

CONTACT_RATE_LIMITER.description: Limits contact form submissions, setup attempts, and Passkey sign-ins to 5 per minute per visitor.
